generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidders should submit the Bid capacity compulsorily. The details of balance work B value (works on hand & works for which tender submitted). Should be submitted in the prescribed format & should be signed by the concerned Executive Engineer / District level officer. In case the bidder does not furnish the above details/suppresses the actual facts/ produces false facts, along with the Technical bid, the technical bid of such bidder shall be considered for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the tender document Attached.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders as on the date of making payment by the client
Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality Assurance authority before use on the work.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Competant Authority reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval.

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Mangalore Division, Mangalore 575001 during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday , the next working day will be considered
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project

Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost. Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment.

When Structure constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing bunds, Structure and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public /private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder

All the items of work as Maintained in the Bill of Quantity (BOQ) are including lead and lift charges loading and unloading charges labour charges all incidental charges hire charges of all machinery and equipment required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per standard technical specification and directions of Engineer in charge of the work
The Rates mentioned in the bid document is excluding GST. The Rates quoted by the bidders shall be exclusive of GST
The intended bidders shall visit the site and quote his offer accordingly and for having visited the site, they should upload the Geo-tag Photos and Document for having visited the site.

EMD for Rs. 100000.00 shall be paid through KARNATAKA PUBLIC procurement PORTAL (KPP) and the Balance of Rs. 43,00,000.00 by Bank Guarantee/e-bank guarantee issued by Nationalised/Scheduled Bank or demand draft/bankers cheque/specified small savings instruments online/ or offline modes of e-payment/Insurance Surety Bonds issued by insurance company authorized by insurance regulatory and development authority of India. Bidder should upload the scanned Copy of such original document issued by Nationalised/Scheduled Bank IN KPP Portal. The bidder has to submit the uploaded original Bank guarantee or other documents which described above before entering the agreement if awarded.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
The tenderer should be a KPWD registered Contractor - Class I Registration and the tenderer should submit registration certificate.

technicalCriterionList.description: Section 3.2(b) i i.One similar nature of work such as Bridge/Road Project comprising major bridge of value not less than Rs.22.00 Crores as prime contractor during last 5 years. (The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed by the competent authority of the department not below the rank of EE).

Section 3.2(b) ii Major single Bridge work (i.e., Bridge work comprising of pre-stressed I/Y/T/Box Girders, Pre-cast RCC Girders) of length not less than 170m bridge and minimum span of 30m in last five years.(i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26)

Section 3.2 (c) Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work in the last five years (i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26). Particulars Quantity Unit 1) Earthwork in both excavation and embankment - 7075 M3, 2) Pile foundation - 389 m, 3) Cement concrete (including RCC and PSC)-1911 M3 4) Steel Reinforcement - 316 MT, 5)Structural Steel - 200 MT

Section 2 ITT 3.7 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value amounting of Rs.4397.72 LAKHS. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity - (AxNx1.5 - B) where A - Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B - Value, at FY 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 36 Months (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.

itemList.description:
Design, construction and maintenance of Bridge Proper Complete- including
access arrangements shown in drawings attached and described in the Tender. The rate shall
including all the related items of geotechnical investigation, Design, construction such as
foundation, sub- structure, super structure, construction of bowstring steel bridge to suit the
NWAI norms i.e minimum 50 m width excluding touch piles and other geometrical requirement
with clear height of 6.00 m as per designs, wearing coat, crash barrier, bearings, expansion joint,
footpath, bridge furnitures, painting & all other items of works covered under the tender to
complete work in all respects with all incidental works and associated expenses and
maintenance. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Design construction and maintenance of Approaches to Bridge shown in
drawings attached and described in the Tender. The rate shall include all the related items of
design, geotechnical investigation construction such as excavation in all types of soil/rock,
construction of retaining wall, embankment formation including its protection, pavement crust,
road furniture & all other items of works covered under the tender to complete work in all
respects with all incidental works and associated expenses with maintenance. For the portion of
approaches includes from the end of bridge deck to the end of asphalt road as shown in the
drawing on either side of the bridge. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.
